metadata.probability_definition: Calibrated current probabilities saved by the paper pipeline in its three assessment windows. Outside those windows and for the fourth threshold, Gaussian approximations use the same calibrated means/SE. These are pointwise exceedances, not a first-passage CDF.
metadata.crossing_definition: First upward crossing, linearly interpolated between adjacent finite annual values.
metadata.benchmark: Realised observational centred 20-year mean, including on anthropogenic panels.
metadata.comparison_fit: Endpoint derivative of a quadratic fitted to 15 past annual current-method outputs.
metadata.recent_saved_fit: Saved rate CSV: 15 annual retrospective outputs when available, otherwise current outputs.
metadata.headline_definition: Current-method warming level; rate from the corrected retrospective 2011–2025 histories, with current proxies where explicitly identified.
metadata.definitive_fit: OLS through centred 10-year means at crossing-5 through crossing+5 inclusive.
metadata.uncertainty: 95% level range: equal-member Gaussian mixture with calibrated method SE. Rates: 1.96 times sqrt(mean(within-fit SE squared)+sample variance of member rates).
metadata.censoring: Comparison crossing-year ranges condition on members that cross. Definitive preindustrial 1.0 C includes the seven requested quartic estimates; their model uncertainty is not included.
